## Description

Buys closed-end funds trading at unusually wide discounts to net asset value, potentially paired with discount/sector hedges or catalysts.

## Where it may fit

Discount widening driven by sentiment or forced selling rather than worsening asset value; catalysts may include tender offers or activist actions.

## Vehicles

Closed-end fund activists, event-driven funds, income portfolios.

## Required data

Fund price and NAV history, distributions, leverage, holdings, fees, tender/buyback/activist events.

## Caveats

Discounts can persist or widen indefinitely; leverage, fees, distribution composition and NAV staleness matter.
